items.q: Do I need to install an app?
items.a: No. Zymplo runs inside the WhatsApp you already use. No download, no annoying signup.

items.q: How do I connect my clients?
items.a: You don't. They text you like always, and the AI handles the rest.

items.q: Is it secure? Is my data protected?
items.a: Yes. CCPA/GDPR compliant, end-to-end encryption. No client sees another client's data.

items.q: What if I don't like it?
items.a: Cancel anytime. No lock-in, no fees. Free plan forever, no card.

items.q: Does it work without a registered business?
items.a: Yes. Sole proprietor, freelancer, professional. If you bill clients, Zymplo works for you.
